name: Bedside monitor
summary: A bedside patient monitor (ECG, pulse oximetry and breathing waveforms, vitals, alarms, beep) with controls to choose the patient and the drug and dose them live
help: Wire a Telemetry block (or a block's Live telemetry) in. Items on the channel (default vitals): hr, sys, dia, map, rr, spo2, temp, rhythm, ectopy (share of ectopic beats), dropped (share of dropped beats), sedation, effect, alarms [..], plasma, unit, state, target, drug, who, regimen, day, speed, patients [..], drugs [..], dose_x, stopped. The controls send {patient}, {drug}, {dose_x}, {give}, {stop}, {restart}, {speed} (each with a seq number) on the control channel (default bedside) to the running blocks. The waveforms are drawn in real time at the current rates.
